messages.subject: Mining Executive Profile | ESG, Government Relations & External Affairs
messages.body:
Dear Nicola,

Absolute Mining & Engineering Recruitment's specialist resources focus makes this a relevant introduction for senior mining leadership mandates.

I currently serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My portfolio spans government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships and executive communications.

I am pursuing Director, VP, Country and Regional roles where mining strategy, regulatory execution, government relationships, social licence and responsible development intersect. I am internationally mobile and open to expatriate appointments across the GCC, Africa, APAC and other global mining markets.

My executive CV is attached for confidential consideration for relevant current or future opportunities.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department
AGM Inc. | Zijin Mining Group
Georgetown, Guyana
